kill_fact: The catalyst is live, dated and binding. The company's 15 Oct 2026 release confirms the FDA accepted the Anaphylm resubmission as a Class 2 response with a PDUFA goal date of 16 Mar 2027, the Q3 release of 4 Nov 2026 reaffirms it, and as of 16 Nov 2026 there is no AdCom, major amendment or slip. The weak link is the downside floor. The record's own parts-sum for a second refusal is $0.95-1.40 a share (on 125,687,705 shares at 30 Sep 2026), yet it sets the floor at $1.75, above its own liquidation math. It also leaves two encumbrances out of the Libervant and Anaphylm values: the Royalty Rights Agreement attached to the 2023 13.5% notes ($28.9M carried as royalty obligations at 30 Sep 2026) and the $62.2M liability for the sale of future revenue. A realistic second-refusal floor is about $1.40, not $1.75. At $3.755 that leaves +37% to an event win of about $5.15 against -63% to the floor, and the price implies roughly 63% odds of approval, not 57%. The record's 72% edge shrinks to about 9 points. The trade survives only as a pure probability bet.
corrections: Downside floor: the record sets $1.75 although its own second-refusal parts-sum is $0.95-1.40 a share. Revised floor is $1.40, the top of the record's own range, before any dilutive raise.

Royalty encumbrances are not netted. The 30 Sep 2026 balance sheet carries $28.9M of royalty obligations (the Royalty Rights Agreement attached to the 2023 13.5% senior notes) and $62.2M of liability for the sale of future revenue. The Royalty Rights Agreement cuts into Anaphylm and Libervant sales value in both legs. Event-win value is trimmed from $5.25 to about $5.15.

Human-factors result overstated. In the August 2026 human-factors study, management said film misplacement fell from 20 participants to 2 and pouch-opening difficulty from 26 to 1. That is not zero use errors, and film placement was itself a CRL deficiency. The top-of-tongue exposure (Cmax just above 100 pg/mL vs 391.7 sublingual; Tmax 35 vs 12 min) therefore goes straight to a cited CRL item, not to a new side question.

Oaktree facility: the May 2026 $150M Oaktree facility had a $55M initial draw (the record's $58.8M presumably includes accreted fees). The approval-conditional tranche ($20M) is confirmed. RTW's $75M is conditional on approval by 30 Jun 2027 (amended Mar 2026), so a major amendment to June 2027 would still be inside the funding deadline.

Libervant: final approval for ages 12+ carries its own PDUFA date of 23 Mar 2027, after the orphan exclusivity ends on 10 Jan 2027. The record presents it only as 'eligible after 10 Jan 2027'. The ages 6-11 PDUFA of 29 Mar 2027 is confirmed.
